input.command:
mkdir -p .perfproof/specs && cat > .perfproof/specs/held_orders.json <<'EOF'
{
  "schema_version": 3,
  "name": "held_orders",
  "command": ["python", "bench.py", "--output", "out/held.txt"],
  "cwd": ".",
  "env": {},
  "metric": {"kind": "reported", "direction": "lower_is_better", "unit": "s"},
  "objective": "wall_time",
  "guardrails": [
    {"metric": "peak_memory", "direction": "lower_is_better", "unit": "bytes", "allowance": 0.1, "allowance_source": "default"},
    {"metric": "peak_gpu_memory", "direction": "lower_is_better", "unit": "bytes", "applicable": false, "reason": "no GPU is used"},
    {"metric": "p99_latency", "direction": "lower_is_better", "unit": "s", "applicable": false, "reason": "serves no requests"}
  ],
  "correctness": {
    "command": ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests"],
    "cwd": ".",
    "timeout_seconds": 300,
    "outputs": [{"path": "out/held.txt", "compare": "text"}]
  },
  "warmup": 1,
  "budget": {"max_rounds": 60, "max_seconds": 1800},
  "looks": {"n0": 10, "k": 10, "max_looks": 6},
  "min_effect": 0.03,
  "alpha": 0.05,
  "timeout_seconds": 120,
  "harness": ["bench.py"],
  "oracle": ["tests/test_orders.py"],
  "inputs": [],
  "config": [],
  "allow_runtime_change": false,
  "allow_cross_host": false
}
EOF
perfproof bench define held_orders --spec .perfproof/specs/held_orders.json --json 2>&1 | head -30
